step.action: Put unattended belongings from 🔧 Camp_Shower in 📦 Lost_and_Found.
Use 🔧 Disposable_Towels to pick up hair, trash, and MOOP.
Put the used towels in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Spray muddy and visibly dirty spots with 🔧 Shower_Cleaner.
Wipe the sprayed spots with 🔧 Disposable_Towels until no mud or visible dirt remains.
Put the used towels in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Use 🔧 Shower_Squeegee to move standing water toward the drain.
Run 🔧 Gray-Water_Pump until the shower basin is empty.
step.ifThen: IF the pump does not remove the water, THEN close the shower, display 🔧 Out_of_Service_Sign, and tell the Dominatrix.

step.action: Inspect under and around the shower for a puddle or leak.
step.ifThen: IF a puddle or leak is present, THEN close the shower, display 🔧 Out_of_Service_Sign, and tell the Dominatrix.

passWhen.criterion: No hair, trash, MOOP, mud, or visible dirt remains.
No puddle or leak is present under or around the shower.
The gray-water pump removed the water.
